Use Continue with a backed-up normal save. Keep emulator save states with their exact ROM version.

This checkpoint restores the Cut tree at Vermilion Gym's entrance. An earlier development build had removed it. The original tree, native Cut interaction and animation, and map re-entry behavior are restored.

Direct tree interactions now accept the Cascade Badge, matching the existing party-menu Cut unlock. HeartGold's Hive Badge remains an alternative. A party member must still know Cut; no move, HM or badge is granted by the patch. Johto map/event/encounter resources are preserved.

All prototype 0032 changes are included, including Yellow's Vermilion Gym teams and Thunderbolt reward.

Please test: teach the captain's Cut HM to a compatible party member, use Cut at the Gym entrance with Cascade, enter and leave the Gym, and Save/Continue. Back up your normal save. If an older save loads directly in Vermilion without the restored tree, enter a building and return to refresh the city objects.

Verified: blocked passage and refusal without the move; normal HM teaching; native Cut offer/animation and passage with Cascade; tree regrowth after a building visit; normal saving and fresh Continue retaining Cut use. Four focused checks cover badge combinations and preservation.

Unfinished: later Kanto campaign, a complete new-game playthrough, optional content and presentation. PC storage remains ten stacks. Tests used a copied high-level party; no new recording is bundled.
